headline: Income Tax Department challenges tax relief granted to Dr Lal PathLabs
hook: Tax dispute returns for Dr Lal PathLabs
summary: The Income Tax Department has filed an appeal against a July 2026 appellate ruling that previously favored Dr Lal PathLabs. This legal challenge stems from an initial assessment order issued in April 2024. Following the news of the appeal, the company's stock price declined by 2.4%.
why_it_matters: Potential tax liability increase could impact company profitability.
winners_losers: Tax department gains / Dr Lal PathLabs hurt
